ideas.pitch: An AI-powered mobile web application designed for GSU students to navigate campus safely at night and access mental health resources instantly.
ideas.title: CampusCare AI: Student Safety & Resource Navigator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses a hyper-local, high-urgency pain point for students attending an urban campus like Georgia State University, making it immediately resonant with local judges.

ideas.pitch: A real-time transit status tracker and predictor leveraging MARTA bus and train data to help students avoid major delays during peak Atlanta traffic.
ideas.title: AtlantaTransit Pulse: Predictive Commute & Crowdsourcing Tool
ideas.why_it_could_win: Relates directly to the everyday logistical frustrations of commuting students in Atlanta, appealing to practical utility and local relevance.

ideas.pitch: A hyper-local peer study group matching platform specifically optimized for GSU course codes, building instant study cohorts based on syllabus milestones.
ideas.title: StudySync Atlanta: Peer Micro-Tutoring & Study Group Matcher
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an immediate academic friction point for college students with a clean, highly demonstrable user interface.

ideas.pitch: A decentralized coordination tool allowing students with extra dining hall meal swipes to securely donate them to peers in need.
ideas.title: GSU Food Security & Meal Swipe Share Network
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on community impact and student welfare, which often scores exceptionally high on social good judging criteria at university hackathons.

ideas.pitch: A localized job board and resume tailoring tool connecting GSU students directly with Atlanta-based tech startups and internships.
ideas.title: Atlanta Career Bridge: AI Resume & Local Job Matcher
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides tangible career outcomes for students, making the pitch immediately compelling to university stakeholders and local judges.
